resources.string:
This app needs your own copy of the game files.

1. Copy your Zero Hour game folder from your PC to this phone (for example into Download). It is the folder that contains INIZH.big and the Data folder (on Steam: Command & Conquer Generals - Zero Hour).
2. Tap "Choose game folder" and pick that folder, or pick a .zip of it.
Game files installed (%1$s).\n\nYou can now delete the copy you put on the phone to free space.

These game files are missing:
%1$s

Pick the Zero Hour folder that contains INIZH.big and the Data folder.
W3D.big, Textures.big and Terrain.big come from the original Generals game. On Steam they are in the ZH_Generals folder: copy the whole Zero Hour folder, including ZH_Generals.
No Zero Hour files found there (INIZH.big is missing). Pick the folder that contains INIZH.big and the Data folder.
